patch_list: Tap any shop item to get it free. No payment, no Google Play popup.
Stops license checks from blocking the game on patched installs.
Blocks all ads and gives reward-ad gifts instantly, no video needed.
Stops Google Play's PAIRIP check from showing an overlay and force-closing the game.
